name: agent-repo-context-reducer-skill
description: Provider-aware repository context reducer and bounded agent runtime with unified dedup, thin model/control planes, adaptive token economics, sandboxing, durable runs, and deterministic verification.

scripts.demo: python3 scripts/repo_context.py context examples/sample-project "payment checkout order" --budget 1800 --pretty
scripts.plan: python3 scripts/repo_context.py plan "Refactor authentication across the repo" --repo . --pretty
scripts.runtime:demo: python3 scripts/repo_context.py runtime execute "Autonomously implement an end-to-end payment migration across the entire project and ship production-ready integration" --repo . --config examples/runtime/subprocess-runtime.json --allow-external-commands --no-context --model-calls 12 --final-case examples/runtime/final-answer-case.json --pretty
scripts.runtime:auto: python3 scripts/repo_context.py runtime execute "fix typo" --repo . --config examples/runtime/subprocess-runtime.json --allow-external-commands --no-context --reduction-mode auto --no-checkpoint --pretty
